branches.description: Unconditional branch that returns the formatted current time.

fields.logic: Formatted from the fixed module-level datetime constant CURRENT_TIME using '%I:%M %p', producing 10:30 AM.

warnings.description: The schema describes getting the current time, but the backend returns a fixed value based on module constant CURRENT_TIME=datetime(2024,9,1,10,30) rather than the actual system current time.
